chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn and Abū Jaʿfar عليهما السلام used to give in charity one-third to their neighbors, one-third to the beggars, and keep one-third for the people of the household.

key_terms.السُّؤَّالِ: the beggars or those who ask
key_terms.لِأَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ: for the members of the household

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn and Imam al-Bāqir عليهما السلام divide their sacrificial offering?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn and Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليهما السلام in dividing sacrificial meat into three portions. It highlights care for neighbors, the needy, and one’s own household, showing a balanced model of charitable distribution.
